hypothesis: Passive maker entry on BTCTMN improves net execution economics during compression regimes after missed fills, adverse selection, fees and exit costs

policies.C: MAKER entry (resting limit at bid) / TAKER exit at horizon
policies.D: MAKER/MAKER - ONLY if defensible fill model exists, else excluded

entry_eligibility: spread < 6 bps sustained >= 60 s (compression episode) AND book quality OK (not locked/crossed) AND data fresh <= 5 s
exit_rule: fixed horizon 60 min from fill; taker exit at ask unless policy D

fill_rules.lower_bound: SELL trade prints strictly below limit price within episode+10min
fill_rules.upper_bound: any SELL print at or below limit

required_independent_sample.effective_n_note: episodes must be non-overlapping; entries per episode capped at 1

statistics.primary: day-block bootstrap 95% CI on mean net per filled entry, policy C minus policy B paired by episode
statistics.promote_if: lower 95% bound > +10 bps net advantage AND fill lower-bound scenario also positive
statistics.reject_if: upper 95% bound < 0 in BOTH fill scenarios with >= min sample

stop_continue.power_rule: verdict only when required sample met; underpowered = INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
stop_continue.no_retuning: spec immutable after freeze; changes require new version file and new prospective window
